about.title: About Wenzhou Deyu Machinery
about.subtitle: Since 2009, we have been manufacturing high-precision shoe sole injection moulding machines in Wenzhou — the global capital of shoe manufacturing.
about.story_p1: Wenzhou Deyu Machinery Co., Ltd was founded in 2009 in Wenzhou, Zhejiang Province — a city that produces more than 70% of China's footwear exports and is home to the world's most concentrated ecosystem of shoe machinery manufacturers.
about.story_p2: We specialize in the design and manufacture of shoe sole injection moulding machines: from entry-level 2-station machines to high-output 20-station rotary lines, from single-color PVC machines to precision dual and multi-color TPU systems.
about.story_p3: Our focus since 2019 has been the transition from traditional rubber and PVC sole production to high-performance TPU. TPU soles are lighter, more durable, and more environmentally responsible — and our machines are at the forefront of this industry shift.
about.story_p4: We are ISO 9001:2000 certified and CE certified, ensuring that our machines meet international quality and safety standards for export to Europe, the Americas, Africa and Asia.
about.certs_subtitle: Our machines meet international quality and safety standards for global export.
about.cta_subtitle: We welcome factory visits. Tell us your schedule and we will arrange a tour of our production facility in Wenzhou.
about.milestone_2016: CE certification for European market compliance
about.milestone_2019: Expanded product line to TPU machines — leading the rubber-to-TPU transition
about.milestone_2024: Machines running in 15 countries across 5 continents
